description: Predictive biomarkers whose therapeutic implication does not depend on the tumor's site of origin (tumor_agnostic), or that apply across a defined subset of tumor types (tumor_subset). This panel is the complement to selected_biomarker_panel.json: that file enumerates protein targets with a binder program, this one enumerates the pan-cancer predictive biomarkers a patient may never have been tested for, of which MSI-H/dMMR and TMB-H gating PD-1 blockade are the canonical examples.
maintenance: Hand-curated. Unlike selected_biomarker_panel.json this file is NOT machine-generated, so it is safe to edit. Add an entry when a new tumor-agnostic indication is approved; do not delete an entry when an approval is withdrawn, mark it in `notes` instead so historical case reports stay interpretable.

provenance.trial_ids_verified: Every nct_id below was resolved against the ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API at curation and matched to the named trial.
provenance.approval_caveat: Approval scope and year are recorded as of curation. Regulatory status changes; the surveyor re-confirms against the current FDA label or regional equivalent before asserting an approval in a case report, and corrects this file when it finds drift.

biomarkers.description: Loss of DNA mismatch repair generates a hypermutated, neoantigen-rich tumor that responds to PD-1 blockade regardless of primary site. The first tumor-agnostic biomarker approval.
biomarkers.default_assay: MMR protein IHC (MLH1, PMS2, MSH2, MSH6) on tumor tissue
assay_alternatives: MSI called from a validated comprehensive NGS panel
biomarkers.threshold: MSI-high by PCR/NGS, or loss of one or more MMR proteins by IHC

therapeutic_implication.scope: Unresectable or metastatic MSI-H / dMMR solid tumors progressing after prior treatment
Recurrent or advanced dMMR solid tumors progressing after prior treatment

reflex_actions: Loss of MLH1 by IHC reflexes to MLH1 promoter hypermethylation / BRAF V600E to separate sporadic from Lynch syndrome
A dMMR result carries germline Lynch implications for the patient and their relatives
biomarkers.notes: IHC and PCR/NGS disagree in a minority of cases, so a negative result on one method with a strong clinical suspicion is a reason to run the other rather than to close the question.

biomarkers.description: A high somatic mutation rate correlates with neoantigen load and with response to PD-1 blockade across primary sites.
biomarkers.default_assay: Validated comprehensive genomic profiling panel reporting TMB in mutations per megabase
assay_alternatives: Whole-exome sequencing with a validated TMB caller
biomarkers.threshold: 10 or more mutations per megabase on a validated assay

therapeutic_implication.scope: Unresectable or metastatic TMB-H solid tumors progressing after prior treatment with no satisfactory alternative

biomarkers.notes: TMB is assay-dependent: panel size, whether synonymous variants are counted, and germline-subtraction method all shift the number, so a value near the cutoff is not interchangeable between platforms. A TMB result from a small hotspot panel does not satisfy this biomarker.

biomarkers.description: A TRK fusion is a rare but strongly actionable oncogenic driver with high response rates to TRK inhibition irrespective of primary site.
biomarkers.default_assay: RNA-based fusion NGS panel covering NTRK1/2/3
assay_alternatives: Pan-TRK IHC as a screen, confirmed by a fusion-capable NGS or FISH assay
DNA-based NGS with intronic tiling across NTRK breakpoints
biomarkers.threshold: An in-frame fusion retaining the TRK kinase domain

therapeutic_implication.scope: Solid tumors with an NTRK gene fusion without a known acquired resistance mutation
Solid tumors with an NTRK gene fusion; CNS-penetrant

Adult and pediatric patients 12 years and older with locally advanced or metastatic NTRK fusion-positive solid tumors that have progressed after treatment or have no satisfactory alternative; retains activity against TRK resistance mutations

biomarkers.notes: DNA-only panels miss fusions with breakpoints in large or poorly-covered introns, so a negative DNA panel is not equivalent to a negative RNA fusion assay. Pan-TRK IHC is a screen, not a confirmation, and stains physiologic TRK in some tissues. Repotrectinib added 2026-08 by the surveyor after confirming the 13 June 2024 tumor-agnostic accelerated approval; it was missing from the 2026-07 curation. All three TRK approvals are written for solid tumors, so use in a hematologic malignancy is off-label.

biomarkers.description: RET fusions drive a subset of thyroid, lung, and rarer solid tumors and respond to selective RET inhibition across primary sites.
biomarkers.default_assay: RNA-based fusion NGS panel covering RET
assay_alternatives: DNA NGS with RET intronic coverage
biomarkers.threshold: An in-frame fusion retaining the RET kinase domain

therapeutic_implication.scope: Locally advanced or metastatic RET fusion-positive solid tumors progressing on or after prior systemic treatment

biomarkers.notes: Distinguish a RET fusion from an activating RET point mutation: the fusion is the tumor-agnostic indication, and the medullary-thyroid point-mutation indication is separate.

biomarkers.description: BRAF V600E is actionable across most primary sites with combined BRAF and MEK inhibition.
biomarkers.default_assay: Tumor NGS panel covering BRAF codon 600
assay_alternatives: VE1 IHC as a screen, confirmed molecularly
biomarkers.threshold: BRAF p.V600E (and, per the approval, V600E specifically rather than any V600 variant)

therapeutic_implication.scope: Unresectable or metastatic BRAF V600E solid tumors progressing after prior treatment, excluding colorectal cancer

biomarkers.notes: Colorectal cancer is carved out of the tumor-agnostic indication because of EGFR-mediated feedback reactivation; it has its own BRAF-directed regimen. Non-V600E class II and III BRAF alterations are not covered by this indication.

biomarkers.description: HER2 IHC 3+ predicts benefit from trastuzumab deruxtecan across primary sites, extending a biomarker that was historically read only in breast and gastric cancer.
biomarkers.default_assay: HER2 IHC on tumor tissue, scored with the tumor-type-appropriate criteria
assay_alternatives: ERBB2 copy number from a comprehensive NGS panel
biomarkers.threshold: IHC 3+ for the tumor-agnostic indication; IHC 1+ and 2+ define HER2-low, which carries separate, tumor-type-specific options

therapeutic_implication.scope: Unresectable or metastatic HER2 IHC 3+ solid tumors after prior systemic treatment with no satisfactory alternative

reflex_actions: An IHC 2+ result reflexes to ISH/FISH
A low-positive (1+) result is a weaker predictor than a high-positive one and should be reported with that hedge
biomarkers.notes: Scoring criteria differ by tumor type; the gastric and pan-tumor conventions label 1+ as negative even where a case-level HER2-low call is clinically meaningful. This biomarker overlaps ERBB2 in selected_biomarker_panel.json; the surveyor emits one row and cross-references rather than duplicating.

biomarkers.description: PD-L1 expression gates or enriches for checkpoint-inhibitor benefit in several tumor types, with a different antibody clone, scoring system, and cutoff in each.
biomarkers.default_assay: PD-L1 IHC using the clone and scoring system validated for this tumor type
biomarkers.threshold: Tumor-type-specific: CPS, TPS, or IC scoring against the cutoff in the relevant indication

therapeutic_implication.approval_status: Approved in specific tumor types, not tumor-agnostic
therapeutic_implication.scope: Cutoff, clone, and scoring differ by indication; confirm against the label for this patient's tumor type

biomarkers.notes: Not a tumor-agnostic biomarker. A PD-L1 result generated for one tumor type's companion diagnostic does not automatically satisfy another indication's requirement, because the clone and scoring differ.

biomarkers.biomarker_label: Homologous recombination deficiency / BRCA1 / BRCA2 pathogenic variant
biomarkers.description: HR deficiency predicts PARP-inhibitor and platinum sensitivity in ovarian, breast, pancreatic, and prostate cancer.
biomarkers.default_assay: Tumor NGS covering HR genes plus a genomic-instability / HRD score
assay_alternatives: Germline multigene panel on whole blood
Somatic BRCA1/2 from a comprehensive tumor panel
biomarkers.threshold: Pathogenic or likely-pathogenic HR gene variant, or an HRD score above the assay's validated cutoff

therapeutic_implication.approval_status: Approved in specific tumor types, not tumor-agnostic
therapeutic_implication.scope: Indication and line of therapy differ by tumor type and by germline versus somatic status

reflex_actions: A somatic BRCA1/2 finding reflexes to germline confirmation, which changes family screening as well as therapy
biomarkers.notes: Somatic-only testing misses a germline finding that would change both treatment and relatives' screening. Reversion mutations under PARP-inhibitor pressure are a separate, later question.

biomarkers.description: TCR-T and ImmTAC therapies against intracellular cancer/testis antigens are restricted to a specific HLA allele, most often HLA-A*02:01. Without a genotype on file, every HLA-presented target in the selected biomarker panel is unassessable rather than negative.
biomarkers.default_assay: HLA class I genotyping at 4-digit resolution on whole blood or buccal swab
assay_alternatives: HLA type inferred from sequencing data by a validated caller
biomarkers.threshold: Allele-level (4-digit) type; the restricting allele depends on the product

therapeutic_implication.approval_status: Product-specific; each names its restricting allele
therapeutic_implication.scope: Gates eligibility for MAGE-A4, NY-ESO-1, PRAME and related intracellular-antigen programs

reflex_actions: A positive HLA type reflexes to antigen-expression testing for the intracellular targets in the selected biomarker panel
biomarkers.notes: Cheap, fast, and drawn from blood rather than tumor tissue, so it is usually the least costly way to open or close a whole class of options. Cross-references every target in selected_biomarker_panel.json with localization intracellular_HLA_presented.
